sources: University of Kentucky Entomology, ENTFACT-439 Sowbugs & Pillbugs: isopods, crustaceans that live on land; seven pairs of legs; pillbugs roll into a ball, which also retains water, sowbugs cannot and have two tail-like uropods; eat decaying plant matter and fungi, sometimes seedlings; do not bite or sting, harmless; females carry eggs and young in a brood pouch (marsupium); live about 3 years; come indoors for moisture and struggle without high humidity; https://entomology.mgcafe.uky.edu/ef439
UF/IFAS EDIS IG093, Pillbugs and sowbugs: the only crustaceans fully adapted to land; beneficial nutrient recyclers; https://edis.ifas.ufl.edu/publication/IG093
